ma.setClipboardData(Object object)

Sets the contents of the system clipboard. After the interface is invoked successfully, a toast message is displayed, indicating that the content has been copied. The message lasts for 1.5 seconds (the earliest version is 24.12. 0).

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
data String Yes Content of the clipboard
success Function No Callback function that is successfully invoked.
fail Function No Callback function that fails to be invoked.
complete Function No Callback function that ends the interface invoking. (This function is executed when the interface is successfully invoked or fails to be invoked.)

Sample Code

ma.setClipboardData({
  data: 'data',
  success (res) {
    ma.getClipboardData({
      success (res) {
        console.log(res.data); 
      }
    });
  }
});

Tips

  1. This API sets the copied content to the system clipboard. Therefore, mini program developers must ensure that the copied content is reasonable and valid. If the content copied by the API is sensitive, the mini program developer shall independently bear the risk of information leakage.
